reason: widened to accept a held MemoryOperand beside a Segment before any release carried materializeMany, so no published code reads the narrower type; options built with segments compile and behave as before, and code that reads a member of operands back as a Segment narrows it first; agreed with the maintainer

widened by one member, 'materializeMany', so a batch reports its latency as the *Into calls do; the events a sink receives keep their shape and a sink with a default branch needs no change, while a sink that switches exhaustively on name adds a case, and a Record<MetricOpName, ...> built by hand (a MetricsSnapshot literal) adds the key, as the type's doc says; agreed with the maintainer
